lesson: Never use wildcard imports (e.g. import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*). Explicitly declare every class to satisfy ktlint.
Never use BasicTextField. Always use OutlinedTextField or TextField from androidx.compose.material3 to avoid decorationBox crashes.
In Material 3, DropdownMenuItem does not take a trailing content lambda. Use DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(...) }, onClick = { ... }).
Never leave // TODO or placeholder comments. Every feature in the PRD must have working, fully implemented Compose UI components.
Only use absolute core icons like List, Settings, Check, Add, Delete, Person. Do not use extended icons like Analytics or CalendarToday without explicitly updating build.gradle.kts.
